findings.issue: פְּנוּ is only the qal imperative 2mp turn. The Spanish adds the noun faces, which no token licenses.
Common noun, feminine singular absolute, left as the transliteration arabá.
H8219 is a common noun (feminine singular absolute), not a proper name. shefelá leaves that non-name lemma untranslated.
H5045 is a common noun (masculine singular absolute), not a proper name. Neguev leaves it untranslated and closes the open sense as a place name.
Proper noun is Hebraized as Lebanón; the locked conventional form is Líbano.

notes: Ustedes imperatives, לכם, the singular gentilics, costa del mar, and río Perat stay inside the tokens.
